subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent, but the unresolved choice is whether this new config surface and opted-in session-state reuse should become an OpenClaw product contract.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored reopen or replacement if this opt-in becomes the accepted contract.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: Keep this PR open for merge review if maintainers accept an explicit `session.restartContinuation` knob for this narrow continuity case.

options.title: Require Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Redirect the work toward a broader restart-recovery design that avoids adding another session config option.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored reopen or replacement if this opt-in becomes the accepted contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior being changed and adjacent Gateway/session tests.
